text: On Amity Island, a New England resort town, a young woman swimming at night is pulled underwater, and police chief Martin Brody wants the beaches closed. Mayor Vaughn, [protecting the summer trade|wrong|the powerful abuse their power], keeps them open, and [the warnings are brushed aside|rules|no one believes you] until a boy dies on a crowded beach. Brody, the oceanographer Hooper and the shark hunter Quint head out on the Orca after [a great white that rams their hull|threat|nature turning on us], deep water slowly swamping the deck.
